observations: All district/year values and the requested Purnia 66%, Kishanganj 60%, six-percentage-point 2023 difference match Table 1 on page 2.

The final site exposes only 2022 and 2023 as selectable years, both controls work without browser errors, and the source-period mention of 2021 is explicitly contextual rather than a selectable value.

The delivered comparison CSV preserves both districts, both years, the six-point difference, unit, source page/table and synthetic-data disclaimer. The page also has a working current-view CSV download.
Table 1 and page 2 are prominent in the page, chat answer and artifact; the synthetic, illustrative and not-official caveats are unambiguous.
The self-contained page works with external network access blocked. It is polished and legible at desktop and 390 px without document overflow; only the phone chart-axis labels are visually cramped.

The four turns took 826.295 seconds. All 50 calls resolved to qwen/qwen3.8-27b (40 Alibaba, 10 Reka), cost USD 1.1053471, and used 1,757,742 prompt plus 46,164 completion tokens including 16,574 reasoning tokens. This is unacceptable harness overhead for the task despite the strong result.
